limits.response: GetResponse: limits v1 plus largeProfile.limits v2/capacity; byte, part, attempt and lifetime limits

part.body: Raw Blob through identity bodySerializer; application/octet-stream. Generated client binary body is string: isolated transport assertion, not textual encoding.
part.response: 200 same status. Preserve immutable key/hash/bytes; read status after failed receipt attempt before resuming. Server increments revision on claim and success/failure.

finalize.response: 200: v1 retained inline; v2 finalizing with job, read status at bounded interval until retained/source is published

status.body: none; returns durable status and current guards

abort.response: 200 status (may abort asynchronously); no cleanup route needed to enroll

enroll.body: sourceId from retained status.source, fresh retained requestKey
enroll.response: 201 same IntakeItem as small retained source

twoParts: GET limits; choose profile/plan from actual file.size
Incremental whole SHA256 in part-sized slices before create; record officer-added timestamp
PUT part 1 key/hash/raw slice and create receipt guards
PUT part 2 key/hash/raw final slice and part-1 receipt guards
POST finalize with last part receipt guards/whole hash
If finalizing: bounded status reads until retained and source; then POST intake/items
refusals: ApiError server message verbatim; 409 requires current read and explicit next action, never guessed revision. 5xx/lost outcome retains same key/body; part transport unknown retains all headers as well. Three failed part sends stop, Try again starts from same part. Abort uses independent retained key.
